captions.instagram:
Concept redesign of a fictional plumber. Not a client project.

When a tap is leaking, people want to call you, now. A lot of trade sites open with a stock handshake photo and a ten-field quote form that promises a reply in a few days.

So we led with an available-now line, real job photos, a three-field price request and a call button that stays on screen the whole way down.

Does your site do this? Free review at prycedigital.com/book

captions.linkedin:
Concept redesign: a fictional plumber’s homepage, rebuilt for the phone.

The old version opens with a stock handshake photo and a ten-field quote form that promises a reply in two to three days. When someone has no hot water, that is two to three days too slow.

The new one leads with an available-now line, shows real job photos, cuts the form to three fields, and keeps a call button on screen the whole way down.

Not a client project. If your trade site does any of this, I am happy to take a look: prycedigital.com/book
